run_make_changelog: run the make_changelog script to extract changelog entries from pybind11 GitHub issues labeled needs changelog
extract_changelog_entries: extract RST changelog entries from GitHub issue bodies using the ENTRY regex pattern
list_missing_changelog_issues: list closed GitHub issues that are missing a suggested changelog entry
format_changelog_with_syntax: format changelog entries using rich Syntax highlighting for RST and Markdown output
query_github_issues: query the pybind11 GitHub repo for closed issues with the needs changelog label using ghapi
